name: smwsprites-flying-rope-v1
title: Flying Rope v1.0
description:
This is "Line-Guided Rope But It's Not Line-Guided" AKA Flying Rope. It is extremely customizable by using the extra bytes. It has many possible flight patterns as well as 4 possible triggers: always move, start moving after grabbed, only move while grabbed, only move when not grabbed. Setting the extra bit makes the rope longer.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by bandicoot
